context.transcript:
And now the weather from Radio KMC.
Many of our listeners I'm sure have made plans to spend the day outside at the Ray Mountain Park and attend the track and field event there this weekend.
I don't know about that, folks.
Our normally bright skies are giving way to heavy storms this coming Thursday and the rain may not let up in time for the event.
Now, in case of rain, you won't be left with nothing to do.
The summer art fair is taking place at the Parks Convention Centre.
The organising committee recommends checking the Ray Mountain Park's website Friday morning to get the latest information.
context.transcript_translation:
现在是来自 Radio KMC 的天气预报。
我确信我们许多听众都计划在这个周末去 Ray Mountain Park 在户外度过一天，并参加那里的田径活动。
我对这个不太确定，各位。
我们通常晴朗的天空周四将迎来大风暴，而且雨水可能来不及为活动停止。
现在，万一下雨，你们不会无所事事。
夏季艺术展正在 Parks Convention Centre 举行。
组织委员会建议大家在周五早上查看 Ray Mountain Park 的网站以获取最新信息。
